messages:
anya: heads-up from sales: a few customers want a 'launchpad' package15-day elevated throughput + priority routing for new projects. they want it simple to turn on.

rafael: sounds like a starter-window variant. key Q: promo as SKU or just a T&Cs addon?

clara: prefer promo SKU so billing shows a line item. customers dislike hidden policies. needs invoice metadata.

anya: ok promo SKU. what limits? sales asked for soft cap: +20k tokens/min per account, route-level safety caps remain.

rafael: runtime note: we should cap per-route and apply a separate token-bucket to avoid head-of-line issues. also track KV cache pressure.

ops-bot: canary build "launchpad-v1" created. scheduled 04:00 UTC for 2% rollout.

sylvia: legal prefers auto-expire plus clear language: "Launchpad Promo: temporary elevated throughput for 15 days from activation, provided as a promotional benefit to eligible accounts." will draft invoice labels.

anya: launch criteria suggestion: (1) p95 latency delta <1.5x in 24h; (2) error rate delta <3%; (3) admin toggle + audit log implemented; (4) invoice promo flows.

clara: sales wants optional manual extension (max one time +7 days) via support ticket. ops wants audit trail.

rafael: agree to manual extension flow; implement TTL and an extensions counter. enforce global concurrent starter cap to limit ops impact.

anya: decision: build promo SKU "Launchpad Promo" 15-day rolling window, default ON for self-serve, Console toggle & support extension, rollout behind feature flag. action items: rafael - API + throttles + canary; sylvia - invoice text; clara - pilot customers + comms; anya - update PRD.

sylvia: sending draft clause to #legal now.

ops-bot: canary deployed to 2% at 04:00 UTC. monitoring hooks enabled.

anya: thanks team. we'll regroup after 24h metrics.
